item.tib: bcud dril bkra shis gter rdzong rgyud las 'phro 'du gsang sgrub man ngag gnad bzhi
item.coloph: de ltar man ngag gnad kyi zab mo bzhi/ skal ldan rnal 'byor khyed kyi snyan du rgyud/ mu stegs ru tra can la gsang du rgya/ man ngag zab mo gcig rgyud swo drig srug/ rang 'dra grogs po gcig rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gnad/ snyigs ma dus mtha' dgos pas gsang spyod gces/ sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ mkha' 'gro mas kho bo byang chub rdo rje'i snyan du brgyud pa smar ro//
